summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for Supplier Ranking overdue follow-up enhancements. Rankings API contract is valid, frontend KPI counts overdue suppliers once, and isolated service tests confirm GHG/Annual Revenue overdue inclusion and submitted-state exclusions while preserving ESG/Documents/Training overdue logic.
action_items: Optional hardening: add a deterministic staging seed scenario with overdue and submitted Annual Revenue to live-validate that branch without relying on ambient data.
Retest ranking overdue modules after any future changes to reporting-period defaults or submission-ledger schemas.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend overdue KPI logic is supplier-scoped (`rankings.filter(row => overdue_modules.length > 0).length`) and does not over-count suppliers with multiple overdue modules.
Ranking read-model integrates GHG overdue via cadence windows and status ledger checks, and Annual Revenue overdue via relationship due date + submitted parent-visible revenue ledger checks.
Live FY 2026-27 ranking payload exposed overdue module labels including ESG Questionnaire, Documents, and GHG Emissions; Annual Revenue path validated in isolated service-level tests.
seed_data_creation: None (read-only live verification + isolated in-test fakes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and public URL from frontend/.env. Live /api/supplier-assessment/rankings returned 200 and frontend overdue KPI matched API overdue supplier count (8) for selected period FY 2026-27, with unique supplier counting parity. No mocked APIs used.
rca of the issue: No regression reproduced. Verified target logic paths: (1) overdue module list enrichment for GHG + revenue conditions, (2) submitted states not marked overdue, (3) existing ESG/Documents/Training overdue logic preserved. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
